subject: Temporary handover & role-lift approval request — 8-week coverage plan
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Temporary handover & role-lift approval request — 8-week coverage plan

Hi Laura + Grace,

Quick heads up: Mateo Alvarez (Platform Eng) confirmed a lateral transfer to Product Infra effective 6/12. He will stay on a short transition but will be unavailable for owner-level work after next Friday. The team has two high-priority commitments that require an owner for the next 8 weeks: the SOC2 remediation epic and the low-latency rollout for the inference cache.

Options considered:
- Promote an existing IC to acting owner (role-lift) for 8 weeks, with a spot bonus and title temporarily modified to Acting Senior Eng Lead.
- Hire an 8-week contractor from Patchwork Labs (vendor quote attached) to cover day-to-day tickets while an internal owner takes on program-level responsibilities.

Recommendation (minimal disruption):
1) Grace assumes acting owner responsibilities for SOC2 remediation (she already knows the audit scope).
2) Approve a role-lift for Grace for 8 weeks with a $6,000 spot bonus (one-time) and temporary title change; she will delegate routine stack tickets to a contractor sourced through Patchwork Labs.
3) Approve the contractor spend (vendor quote attached) not to exceed $48k for 8 weeks. We would pay from the eng contingency pool; if we need an additional headcount transfer from another team that would require HC approval.

Attachments: handover_checklist.xlsx (projected task list & owner map), org_role_map_v3.pdf (who covers what if Grace is elevated). Also pasted a short timeline below.

Timeline:
- 6/07: finalize handover doc and vendor contract
- 6/12: Mateo final day of owner work; Grace takes over as acting owner
- 6/12–8/07: contractor handles routing and day-to-day tickets; Grace runs weekly syncs with stakeholders
- 8/09: review — either reassign permanent owner or open a permanent HC req

Asks: Laura / Karthik — approval to pull $48k from the eng contingency pool and to grant the spot bonus for Grace. Quick replies welcome; if you want a short 15-min sync I can set one up this afternoon.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Engineering Operations
Redwood Inference

Thanks for the clear plan, Marissa. I agree in principle that minimizing disruption is the priority; Grace is the logical choice for SOC2 oversight. A couple quick items before I sign off: 

1) Budget: provide a 1-line cost breakdown including taxes/fees for the contractor and confirm if the $48k is inclusive of Patchwork's 10% placement fee.
2) HR/Comp: we need a written confirmation from People Ops that a $6k spot bonus + temporary title change is within policy and doesn't create a permanent comp delta. If People Ops needs to be looped, please add them to the thread; if not, include the policy reference.
3) Risk: confirm the critical on-call and post-incident owner coverage for the low-latency rollout. Who is the after-hours pager?

If you can get the vendor quote and the payroll confirmation this afternoon I can approve the contingency transfer. Otherwise we can put an interim approval through (Laura sign-off) with a documented 48-hour post-approval check.

Laura Bennett
VP Engineering
Redwood Inference
